scripts.build: yarn clean && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && yarn fix-imports
scripts.dev: concurrently "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --watch" "nodemon --watch ../../dist/electron --ext js --ignore '**/*.d.ts' --delay 1000ms --exec 'yarn fix-imports && NODE_ENV=development yarn electron ../../dist/electron/main.js'"
